# Lumberjack Insurance

> Logging & forestry contractor insurance by Contractors Choice Agency. Workers' comp for logging class codes (2702/2710/2712), log trucks & ICC filings, equipment/inland marine, forestry pollution, and sawmill coverage. Licensed all 50 states. 15-minute quote turnaround, 2-hour claims response.

Lumberjack Insurance is the logging, timber, and forestry program of Contractors Choice Agency (CCA), founded in 2005 by former contractor Josh Cotner. CCA is licensed in all 50 states (NPN #8608479) and holds direct appointments with the A-rated specialty insurance markets that underwrite logging class codes that most standard carriers decline.

## What we do
- Write workers' comp for logging class codes 2702 (logging), 2710 (sawmill/planing mill), and 2712 (logging road construction) — with EMOD (experience modification factor) strategy.
- Quote log truck and commercial auto programs — physical damage, motor truck cargo, bobtail/non-trucking, MTGC, and federal ICC/MC Form E and Form H filings.
- Schedule logging equipment on inland marine floaters — feller bunchers, skidders, forwarders, delimbers, knuckle-boom loaders, cable yarders, and chainsaws.
- Write General Liability with the Loggers Broad Form endorsement (LCP) for logging operations, plus loading/unloading liability at the landing and mill.
- Write sawmill and property coverage — stationary and portable mills, kilns, lumber yards, and equipment breakdown.
- Write Contractors Pollution Liability (CPL) for forestry — fuel/hydraulic spills, sediment/erosion runoff, wetlands disturbance.
- Write tree service and arborist insurance (class 9102 GL, 0106 workers' comp).
- Coordinate the four monopolistic state funds (OH, WA, ND, WY), Oregon SAIF, and Idaho submissions.

## Coverage lines (service pages)
- [Loggers' Workers' Compensation](https://lumberjackinsurance.com/services/loggers-workers-comp) — class codes 2702/2710/2712, EMOD strategy

- [Logging Equipment / Inland Marine](https://lumberjackinsurance.com/services/logging-equipment-insurance) — feller bunchers, skidders, yarders
- [General Liability — Forestry & Timber](https://lumberjackinsurance.com/services/forestry-timber-liability) — Loggers Broad Form / LCP
- [Sawmill & Property](https://lumberjackinsurance.com/services/sawmill-insurance) — mills, kilns, lumber yards
- [Pollution Liability — Forestry](https://lumberjackinsurance.com/services/logging-pollution-liability) — spills, erosion, wetlands
- [Tree Service & Arborist](https://lumberjackinsurance.com/services/tree-service-arborist-insurance) — class 9102 / 0106
